_doc: Achievements. Each family turns into one achievement per goal (id 'family-goal'). 'stat' names a number worked out in js/game/achievements.js from the save; '{n}' in 'desc' is the goal and '{breed}' the priciest shop breed. A goal of "all" means every sheep in the shop. 'titles' name each step (bronze, silver, gold, diamond). Tell families are generated from 'tellKinds' × 'tellGoals': one per wolf part in data/tells.json → 'kind'. Unlocks are stored in the save, so renaming a family's id re-earns it.

families.name: Wolf Stampede
families.desc: Tap {n} wolves in one Wolf Stampede

families.name: Speed
families.desc: Catch {n} wolves fast enough for the full speed bonus

families.name: Collector
families.desc: Buy one of every kind of sheep in the shop
